# Cashlo

> Cashlo is India's UPI CashPoint network — it helps retailers and local shop owners become UPI CashPoints / distributors, offering cash withdrawal, money transfer, bill payments, and merchant banking services through a simple pincode-based onboarding flow.

## Company

- [About](https://www.cashlo.app/about): Who Cashlo is and what the CashPoint network does.
- [Contact](https://www.cashlo.app/contact): How to reach Cashlo.
- [FAQ](https://www.cashlo.app/faq): Common questions about becoming a distributor/merchant and using Cashlo's services.

## Become a Distributor / Merchant

- [Become a Distributor](https://www.cashlo.app/become-distributor): Reserve a pincode and activate as a Cashlo distributor/UPI CashPoint.
- [Become a Merchant](https://www.cashlo.app/become-merchant): Lead-capture for merchants interested in Cashlo services.

## Services

- [Services](https://www.cashlo.app/services): Overview of Cashlo's service catalogue.
- [UPI CashPoint](https://www.cashlo.app/upi-cashpoint): Cash withdrawal / UPI-based cash access at local shops.
- [QuickKhata](https://www.cashlo.app/quickkhata): Digital credit/ledger tracking for shopkeepers, replacing paper bahi-khatas.
- [Instant Loan](https://www.cashlo.app/services/instant-loan): Instant loan service details.
- [Gold Loan](https://www.cashlo.app/services/gold-loan): Gold loan service details.
- [ITR Filing](https://www.cashlo.app/services/itr-filing): Income tax return filing service.
- [Recharge & Bill Payments](https://www.cashlo.app/services/recharge-bills): Mobile recharge and utility bill payment service.

## Tools

- [Calculators](https://www.cashlo.app/calculators): EMI, SIP, SWP, FD, and RD financial calculators.

## Content

- [Blog](https://www.cashlo.app/blog): Articles on UPI, digital payments, merchant banking, and fintech.
